item.title: Akron Zoo plans $21 million expansion, adding more animals
item.description: The Akron Zoo confirmed to FOX 8 News on Wednesday that it is planning a multi-million dollar expansion.

item.title: Spirit Airlines is departing from Cleveland airport
item.description: After more than a decade at Cleveland Hopkins International Airport, Spirit Airlines has reportedly made the decision to stop all of their flights going in and out of the city.

item.title: Suspected serial burglar released from jail, wanted again: I-Team
item.description: The FOX 8 I-Team has found a suspected serial burglar wanted again after a judge let him out of jail on bond and a GPS monitoring device.

item.title: Honda shows off dependable lineup at Cleveland Auto Show
item.description: Honda is well known for being one of the most dependable brands in the auto industry, a reputation earned over decades with vehicles made right here in Ohio.

item.title: Burger King making first changes to the Whopper in nearly a decade
item.description: Burger King fans may notice a few changes to the fast food giant's best-selling menu item.

item.title: Nearly blind refugee found dead after border agents drop him off at donut shop
item.description: A nearly blind refugee from Myanmar who disappeared after U.S. Border Patrol agents dropped him off at a Buffalo doughnut shop was found dead on the street five days later, prompting a police investigation and complaints from city officials that he'd been abandoned without care for his safety.

item.title: Mountain lion snatches dog right in front of owner in California
item.description: A Southern California woman is devastated after her beloved Shih Tzu was snatched by a mountain lion right in front of her late Monday night.

item.title: Driver speaks out on Cleveland school bus danger: I-Team
item.description: A Cleveland Metropolitan School bus driver told the I-Team a maintenance worker called her bus a "death trap" since it had fallen into such disrepair.

item.title: Forecast: Staying cold overnight, but reaching 50s on Friday
item.description: After a cold day, we are staying cold tonight. Temperatures will hang out in the 30s and 20s tonight.

item.title: 'Do It For James': Bill criminalizing sextortion clears major hurdle
item.description: A proposed new federal law, that was inspired by the suicide of a Streetsboro High School student victimized by the online crime known as sextortion, cleared a major hurdle on Thursday.
